basic_profile.bio: I'm an aspiring game modder and part-time IT student from Wellington, New Zealand. I recently discovered my passion for submarine simulations and have been diving deep into Barotrauma modding. When I'm not experimenting with game mods, I enjoy exploring the latest Linux distributions and trying out different privacy-focused protocols like Haven. I'm typically online in the evenings, New Zealand time, and love connecting with others who have niche tech interests. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to explore new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational knowledge of IT from my ongoing studies and am largely self-taught in game modding, particularly with Barotrauma. My interest in Linux systems has expanded my technical skills, and I frequently engage with online communities to learn more about open-source software.
